model.title: Biosimilar Red Tape Elimination Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Mike Lee (R-UT)

summary.text: The bill would automatically deem all biosimilars approved by the FDA to be interchangeable with their original brand-name biological products, eliminating additional testing requirements currently needed to earn that designation. This would allow pharmacists to substitute biosimilars for brand-name drugs more easily, though it would preserve the exclusive marketing period for the first biosimilar approved for each reference product.
